confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vietnamese provincial tourism pricing, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation tiers are less certain because Ninh Binh's homestay and guesthouse market varies widely by season and location. Cocktail and wine are set from the local price relationship to beer (roughly 4-5x a draught beer), because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. July is peak season, so accommodation may run above the estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Vietnamese tourism towns of similar scale and visitor profile, such as Hoi An, Hue and Da Nang, adjusted down for Ninh Binh's smaller size and homestay-heavy accommodation. Hanoi prices were not used directly.
